slots.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

slots.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.

slots.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

slots.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.

slots.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
